cards.intuition: Use non-overlapping clocks, overlapping rolling intervals, or inactivity-based groups to match the business question.
Rolling views increase state because one event can belong to several windows.
cards.formula: approximate windows per event = window_size / period

cards.intuition: Estimate event-time progress for on-time firing without claiming earlier events are impossible.
cards.formula: watermark passes window end -> on-time eligibility

cards.intuition: Retain window state for bounded late corrections, balancing completeness against state and update cost.
cards.formula: cleanup after window end + allowed lateness in watermark time

cards.intuition: Choose early, on-time, and late moments when a window emits observable panes.
cards.formula: pane timing = trigger(window state, watermark, processing time)

cards.intuition: Emit full replacement aggregates or only new deltas, and make sink semantics match.
cards.formula: accumulating: total so far; discarding: delta since firing

cards.intuition: Retry to avoid expected loss while assuming the same logical event can be delivered again.
Combine stable event or result identity with idempotent sink writes under retry.
cards.formula: same input ID -> same output key and final state

cards.intuition: Name which source offsets, state, side effects, and sink commits share a coordinated transaction.
cards.formula: guarantee scope must include every claimed effect

cards.intuition: Ack only after the required effect is committed, while remaining safe under redelivery.
cards.topic: Pub/Sub Delivery Semantics: Acks, Ordering Keys, Dead-Letter Queues

cards.intuition: Preserve sequence within a business entity while allowing different keys to process in parallel.
cards.topic: Pub/Sub Delivery Semantics: Acks, Ordering Keys, Dead-Letter Queues

cards.intuition: Quarantine bounded-retry failures with lineage, repair them, and replay using original identity.
cards.formula: retry -> DLQ -> diagnose -> repair -> idempotent replay
cards.topic: Pub/Sub Delivery Semantics: Acks, Ordering Keys, Dead-Letter Queues
